Tailoring has two aspects: first, you use it to turn textiles into
clothing. Second, you can use tailoring to make clothing and leather
armor more comfortable, more useful, or more stylish.
Tailoring Overview
Tailoring
is the craft that turns raw textiles into cloth equipment. You can also give certain enhancements to cloth and leather gear, such as pockets (extra inventory space) and elemental damages.
In-Game Description
Tailoring has two aspects: first, you use it to turn textiles into clothing. Second, you can use tailoring to make clothing and leather armor more comfortable, more useful, or more stylish.
Training Tailoring
Thimble Pete
will teach you Tailoring
Legs
will teach Tailoring recipes to players in animal form for Spider Casings. She also teaches textile recipes for various spider silk.
Shirogin
will unlock levels 51-60 and levels 61-70 and teaches 51+ Tailoring recipes.
Elaina
can also unlock levels 51-60 and 61-70, as well as teach many Tailoring recipes.
Gurki
can teach you how to make camo clothing and add pockets to clothes.
Eveline Rastin
can teach you how to make nimble clothing.
Felmer
will unlock levels 71-80 and teaches 80+ Tailoring recipes.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Dunahain Broadarm
deep beneath
Povus
.

Tailoring Mechanics
Ending up with extra textiles
Because multiple Textile Creation recipes create and use odd amounts of fabric (Cotton Thread creates 4 every time, but most recipes using it only require 1), you'll often end up with extra materials while Tailoring. For most equipment recipes, the magic number is 8: every 8 pieces of gear, you'll have no materials left.
